# Precision Metronome
> High-precision, zero-drift web metronome supporting arbitrary float BPM and millisecond accuracy.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-millisecond timing precision powered by Web Audio API hardware audio clock.
- Supports arbitrary floating-point BPM inputs (e.g., 96.05 BPM) for video sync and tempo-locked pieces.
- Optical screen flash synchronized to screen refresh rate with zero cumulative drift.
- Online Demo: https://defei-wang.github.io/precision-metronome/
